reference.title: DescribeInstances / Instance / Reservation (Amazon EC2 API Reference)
reference.version: EC2 API version 2016-11-15; documented response encoding is XML

chosen_surface.why: The EC2 API Reference publishes an exhaustive field-by-field list for the Instance object. The AWS Config AWS::EC2::Instance configuration item has NO published per-resource-type property schema.
chosen_surface.config_alternative: AWS::EC2::Instance is a supported AWS Config resource type, but resource-config-reference.html documents only its relationships and redirects to the CloudFormation resource and property types reference for properties.

delivery.export_mechanism_note: DescribeInstances is a paginated read API. AWS does not document an export of it to S3 or any durable artifact. The only documented durable path is indirect, via the AWS Config AWS::EC2::Instance configuration item, whose field mapping is itself not published.
delivery.format_note: The EC2 API Reference documents the XML response only. No JSON property schema or JSON example is published for DescribeInstances.
